g.text: New Fig. 3 runs | latency distributions without first JIT call
One 60 s episode per method; correlated time samples, not independent repetitions.
Optimizer/interface use MPC calls; other components use all steady steps.
The 2 ms line is a whole-step target. Simulation sampling does not establish robot real-time control.
